task.title: Inputting the decision on a blocked claim

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 3.
If all rows are blank, go to step 5.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, repeat step 3.
If all rows are blank, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Review the Summary tab, then select the Allocations link and determine if there is a W allocation on file:
Select the BPC to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, do the following:

ul.li: Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: On the Allocations tab, in the Allocations section, input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Start date: Enter the start date of the W allocation.
End date: Enter the end date of the W allocation.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction and determine if it is correct:

ul.li: If yes, select Close and go to step 10.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.

step.cmd: Determine if an FWW code must be removed for any of the claimant’s reports under review and applied to an OP that will be created:
In FTS, select the BPC to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .

step.cmd: On the Allocation “A” tab, in the Amended Earnings and FWW columns, modify the week of the FWW as follows:

ul.li:
Select the week that requires a change. Repeat for every week that requires a change.
Amended earnings: remove the earnings.
FWW: Select the new FWW code.
Detection: Select 97 - EI ERB – Compliance .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If a D47 that is already imposed must be modified, go to step 16.
If a D47 that is already imposed must be rescinded and a new disentitlement must be input, go to step 17.
If a D47 that is already imposed must be rescinded and no new disentitlement must be input, go to step 23.
If a new D47 must be input, go to step 31.

step.cmd: Determine if the start and end dates of the disentitlements must be modified:

ul.li: If only the end dates must be modified, go to step 27.

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To clear the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .

step.cmd: Determine if the client must be notified of a disentitlement:
In ACS, create and send the C-71-05-01 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Earnings / insurable hours of work / income while on claim (12577)

ul.li: Choice of phrases decision letter to claimant (12610): Select the appropriate option.
Since we have not received a response from you / After reviewing your response (12612)

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Report for Investigation (IC70) screen, select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li:
Overpayment: Select OP .
Reason: Select Other .
Amount: Enter the OP.

Reason: Select Other and type the appropriate option:
“EI ERB eligibility not proven — D47 imposed from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].”
“EI ERB eligibility proven — D47 not imposed.”
